dashboard.label: Security Audit
dashboard.description: Audit weak ciphers, deprecated TLS protocols, self-signed certificates, and revocation anomalies.

table.title: Insecure Protocol & Weak Cipher Suite Audit

search.query: `ssl_cert_index` `ssl_cert_sourcetype` status!="CONNECTION_ERROR" | stats latest(ssl_version) as ssl_version, latest(ssl_cipher) as ssl_cipher, latest(issuer_cn) as issuer_cn, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | search ssl_version IN ("TLSv1", "TLSv1.1", "SSLv2", "SSLv3") OR ssl_cipher="*RC4*" OR ssl_cipher="*3DES*" OR ssl_cipher="*NULL*" | eval Target=dest . ":" . dest_port, last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") | table Target, sni, ssl_version, ssl_cipher, issuer_cn, last_seen | rename Target as "Endpoint", sni as "SNI", ssl_version as "Protocol", ssl_cipher as "Negotiated Cipher", issuer_cn as "CA Issuer", last_seen as "Audit Timestamp"

`ssl_cert_index` `ssl_cert_sourcetype` status!="CONNECTION_ERROR" | stats latest(is_self_signed) as is_self_signed, latest(subject_cn) as subject_cn, latest(issuer_cn) as issuer_cn, latest(signature_algorithm) as signature_algorithm, latest(valid_to) as valid_to, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | search is_self_signed=true OR is_self_signed="true" | eval Endpoint=dest . ":" . dest_port, last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") | table Endpoint, sni, subject_cn, issuer_cn, signature_algorithm, valid_to, last_seen | rename Endpoint as "Endpoint", sni as "SNI", subject_cn as "Common Name", issuer_cn as "Issuer", signature_algorithm as "Signature Algorithm", valid_to as "Valid Until", last_seen as "Last Detected"

`ssl_cert_index` `ssl_cert_sourcetype` (status!="VALID" AND status!="EXPIRING_WARNING" AND status!="EXPIRING_CRITICAL") OR revocation_status="REVOKED" | stats count, latest(status) as status, latest(revocation_status) as revocation_status, latest(revocation_reason) as revocation_reason, latest(error) as error_message, latest(_time) as last_seen by dest, dest_port, sni | eval Endpoint=dest . ":" . dest_port, Issue_Detail=coalesce(revocation_reason, error_message, status, "Unknown Failure"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC") | sort - count | table Endpoint, sni, status, revocation_status, Issue_Detail, count, last_seen | rename Endpoint as "Endpoint", sni as "SNI", status as "Status", revocation_status as "OCSP State", Issue_Detail as "Failure / Revocation Reason", count as "Event Count", last_seen as "Last Detected"
